versos.grego: Καὶ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ τρίτῃ γάμος ἐγένετο ἐν Κανὰ τῆς Γαλιλαίας, καὶ ἦν ἡ μήτηρ τοῦ Ἰησοῦ ἐκεῖ·

controles.web: The third day, there was a marriage in Cana of Galilee. Jesus’ mother was there.
controles.kjv: And the third day there was a marriage in Cana of Galilee; and the mother of Jesus was there:
controles.livre: E no terceiro dia houve um casamento em Caná da Galileia; e a mãe de Jesus estava ali.

versos.grego: ἐκλήθη δὲ καὶ ὁ Ἰησοῦς καὶ οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ εἰς τὸν γάμον.

controles.web: Jesus also was invited, with his disciples, to the marriage.
controles.kjv: And both Jesus was called, and his disciples, to the marriage.
controles.livre: E também Jesus foi convidado com seus discípulos ao casamento.

versos.grego: καὶ ὑστερήσαντος οἴνου λέγει ἡ μήτηρ τοῦ Ἰησοῦ πρὸς αὐτόν Οἶνον οὐκ ἔχουσιν.

controles.web: When the wine ran out, Jesus’ mother said to him, “They have no wine.”
controles.kjv: And when they wanted wine, the mother of Jesus saith unto him, They have no wine.
controles.livre: E tendo faltado vinho, a mãe de Jesus lhe disse: Não têm vinho.

versos.grego: καὶ λέγει αὐτῇ ὁ Ἰησοῦς Τί ἐμοὶ καὶ σοί, γύναι; οὔπω ἥκει ἡ ὥρα μου.

controles.web: Jesus said to her, “Woman, what does that have to do with you and me? My hour has not yet come.”
controles.kjv: Jesus saith unto her, Woman, what have I to do with thee? mine hour is not yet come.
controles.livre: Jesus lhe disse: O que eu tenho contigo, mulher? A minha hora ainda não chegou.

versos.grego: λέγει ἡ μήτηρ αὐτοῦ τοῖς διακόνοις Ὅ τι ἂν λέγῃ ὑμῖν, ποιήσατε.

controles.web: His mother said to the servants, “Whatever he says to you, do it.”
controles.kjv: His mother saith unto the servants, Whatsoever he saith unto you, do it.
controles.livre: Sua mãe disse aos serventes: Fazei tudo quanto ele vos disser.

versos.grego: ἦσαν δὲ ἐκεῖ λίθιναι ὑδρίαι ἓξ κατὰ τὸν καθαρισμὸν τῶν Ἰουδαίων κείμεναι, χωροῦσαι ἀνὰ μετρητὰς δύο ἢ τρεῖς.

controles.web: Now there were six water pots of stone set there after the Jews’ way of purifying, containing two or three metretes apiece.
controles.kjv: And there were set there six waterpots of stone, after the manner of the purifying of the Jews, containing two or three firkins apiece.
controles.livre: E estavam ali postos seis vasos de pedra, conforme à purificação dos judeus, em cada uma cabiam duas ou três metretas.  )

versos.grego: λέγει αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς Γεμίσατε τὰς ὑδρίας ὕδατος. καὶ ἐγέμισαν αὐτὰς ἕως ἄνω.

controles.web: Jesus said to them, “Fill the water pots with water.” They filled them up to the brim.
controles.kjv: Jesus saith unto them, Fill the waterpots with water. And they filled them up to the brim.
controles.livre: Disse-lhes Jesus: Enchei estes vasos com água. E encheram-nas até encima.

versos.grego: καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς Ἀντλήσατε νῦν καὶ φέρετε τῷ ἀρχιτρικλίνῳ. οἱ δὲ ἤνεγκαν.

controles.web: He said to them, “Now draw some out, and take it to the ruler of the feast.” So they took it.
controles.kjv: And he saith unto them, Draw out now, and bear unto the governor of the feast. And they bare it.
controles.livre: E disse-lhes: Agora tirai, e a levai ao mestre de cerimônia. Então levaram.

versos.grego: ὡς δὲ ἐγεύσατο ὁ ἀρχιτρίκλινος τὸ ὕδωρ οἶνον γεγενημένον, καὶ οὐκ ᾔδει πόθεν ἐστίν, οἱ δὲ διάκονοι ᾔδεισαν οἱ ἠντληκότες τὸ ὕδωρ, φωνεῖ τὸν νυμφίον ὁ ἀρχιτρίκλινος

controles.web: When the ruler of the feast tasted the water now become wine, and didn’t know where it came from (but the servants who had drawn the water knew), the ruler of the feast called the bridegroom,
controles.kjv: When the ruler of the feast had tasted the water that was made wine, and knew not whence it was: (but the servants which drew the water knew;) the governor of the feast called the bridegroom,
controles.livre: E quando o mestre de cerimônia experimentou a água feita vinho (sem saber de onde era, porém os serventes que haviam tirado a água sabiam), o mestre de cerimônia chamou o noivo,

versos.grego: καὶ λέγει αὐτῷ Πᾶς ἄνθρωπος πρῶτον τὸν καλὸν οἶνον τίθησιν, καὶ ὅταν μεθυσθῶσιν τὸν ἐλάσσω· σὺ τετήρηκας τὸν καλὸν οἶνον ἕως ἄρτι.

controles.web: and said to him, “Everyone serves the good wine first, and when the guests have drunk freely, then that which is worse. You have kept the good wine until now!”
controles.kjv: And saith unto him, Every man at the beginning doth set forth good wine; and when men have well drunk, then that which is worse: but thou hast kept the good wine until now.
controles.livre: E disse-lhe: Todos põem primeiro o vinho bom, e quando os convidados já estão bêbados, então se dá o pior; porém tu guardaste o bom vinho até agora.

versos.grego: Ταύτην ἐποίησεν ἀρχὴν τῶν σημείων ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἐν Κανὰ τῆς Γαλιλαίας καὶ ἐφανέρωσεν τὴν δόξαν αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἐπίστευσαν εἰς αὐτὸν οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: This beginning of his signs Jesus did in Cana of Galilee, and revealed his glory; and his disciples believed in him.
controles.kjv: This beginning of miracles did Jesus in Cana of Galilee, and manifested forth his glory; and his disciples believed on him.
controles.livre: Este princípio de sinais Jesus fez em Caná da Galileia, e manifestou sua glória; e seus discípulos creram nele.

versos.grego: Μετὰ τοῦτο κατέβη εἰς Καφαρναοὺμ αὐτὸς καὶ ἡ μήτηρ αὐτοῦ καὶ οἱ ἀδελφοὶ καὶ οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἐκεῖ ἔμειναν οὐ πολλὰς ἡμέρας.

controles.web: After this, he went down to Capernaum, he, and his mother, his brothers, and his disciples; and they stayed there a few days.
controles.kjv: After this he went down to Capernaum, he, and his mother, and his brethren, and his disciples: and they continued there not many days.
controles.livre: Depois disto desceu a Cafarnaum, ele e sua mãe, seus irmãos, e seus discípulos, e ficaram ali não muitos dias.

versos.grego: Καὶ ἐγγὺς ἦν τὸ πάσχα τῶν Ἰουδαίων, καὶ ἀνέβη εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα ὁ Ἰησοῦς.

controles.web: The Passover of the Jews was at hand, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.
controles.kjv: And the Jews’ passover was at hand, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem,
controles.livre: E estava perto a Páscoa dos judeus, e Jesus subiu a Jerusalém.

versos.grego: καὶ εὗρεν ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ τοὺς πωλοῦντας βόας καὶ πρόβατα καὶ περιστερὰς καὶ τοὺς κερματιστὰς καθημένους,

controles.web: He found in the temple those who sold oxen, sheep, and doves, and the changers of money sitting.
controles.kjv: And found in the temple those that sold oxen and sheep and doves, and the changers of money sitting:
controles.livre: E achou no Templo os que vendiam bois, ovelhas, e pombas, e os cambistas sentados.

versos.grego: καὶ ποιήσας φραγέλλιον ἐκ σχοινίων πάντας ἐξέβαλεν ἐκ τοῦ ἱεροῦ τά τε πρόβατα καὶ τοὺς βόας, καὶ τῶν κολλυβιστῶν ἐξέχεεν τὰ κέρματα καὶ τὰς τραπέζας ἀνέτρεψεν,

controles.web: He made a whip of cords, and threw all out of the temple, both the sheep and the oxen; and he poured out the changers’ money, and overthrew their tables.
controles.kjv: And when he had made a scourge of small cords, he drove them all out of the temple, and the sheep, and the oxen; and poured out the changers’ money, and overthrew the tables;
controles.livre: E tendo feito um açoite com cordas, lançou todos para fora do Templo, assim como as ovelhas, e os bois; e espalhou o dinheiro dos cambistas, e virou as mesas.

versos.grego: καὶ τοῖς τὰς περιστερὰς πωλοῦσιν εἶπεν Ἄρατε ταῦτα ἐντεῦθεν, μὴ ποιεῖτε τὸν οἶκον τοῦ Πατρός μου οἶκον ἐμπορίου.

controles.web: To those who sold the doves, he said, “Take these things out of here! Don’t make my Father’s house a marketplace!”
controles.kjv: And said unto them that sold doves, Take these things hence; make not my Father’s house an house of merchandise.
controles.livre: E aos que vendiam pombas, disse: Tirai isto daqui; e não torneis a casa de meu Pai uma casa de comércio!

versos.grego: ἐμνήσθησαν οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ ὅτι γεγραμμένον ἐστίν Ὁ ζῆλος τοῦ οἴκου σου καταφάγεταί με.

controles.web: His disciples remembered that it was written, “Zeal for your house will eat me up.”
controles.kjv: And his disciples remembered that it was written, The zeal of thine house hath eaten me up.
controles.livre: E lembraram-se seus discípulos que está escrito: O zelo de tua casa me tem me devorado.

versos.grego: ἀπεκρίθησαν οὖν οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι καὶ εἶπαν αὐτῷ Τί σημεῖον δεικνύεις ἡμῖν, ὅτι ταῦτα ποιεῖς;

controles.web: The Jews therefore answered him, “What sign do you show us, seeing that you do these things?”
controles.kjv: Then answered the Jews and said unto him, What sign shewest thou unto us, seeing that thou doest these things?
controles.livre: Responderam pois os Judeus, e disseram-lhe: Que sinal nos mostras de que fazes estas coisas?

versos.grego: ἀπεκρίθη Ἰησοῦς καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Λύσατε τὸν ναὸν τοῦτον, καὶ ἐν τρισὶν ἡμέραις ἐγερῶ αὐτόν.

controles.web: Jesus answered them, “Destroy this temple, and in three days I will raise it up.”
controles.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto them, Destroy this temple, and in three days I will raise it up.
controles.livre: Respondeu Jesus, e disse-lhes: Derrubai este Templo, e em três dias o levantarei.

versos.grego: εἶπαν οὖν οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι Τεσσεράκοντα καὶ ἓξ ἔτεσιν οἰκοδομήθη ὁ ναὸς οὗτος, καὶ σὺ ἐν τρισὶν ἡμέραις ἐγερεῖς αὐτόν;

controles.web: The Jews therefore said, “It took forty-six years to build this temple! Will you raise it up in three days?”
controles.kjv: Then said the Jews, Forty and six years was this temple in building, and wilt thou rear it up in three days?
controles.livre: Os judeus, pois, disseram: Durante quarenta e seis anos este Templo foi edificado, e tu o levantarás tu em três dias?

versos.grego: ἐκεῖνος δὲ ἔλεγεν περὶ τοῦ ναοῦ τοῦ σώματος αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: But he spoke of the temple of his body.
controles.kjv: But he spake of the temple of his body.
controles.livre: Porém ele falava do Templo de seu corpo.

versos.grego: ὅτε οὖν ἠγέρθη ἐκ νεκρῶν, ἐμνήσθησαν οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ ὅτι τοῦτο ἔλεγεν, καὶ ἐπίστευσαν τῇ γραφῇ καὶ τῷ λόγῳ ὃν εἶπεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς.

controles.web: When therefore he was raised from the dead, his disciples remembered that he said this, and they believed the Scripture, and the word which Jesus had said.
controles.kjv: When therefore he was risen from the dead, his disciples remembered that he had said this unto them; and they believed the scripture, and the word which Jesus had said.
controles.livre: Portanto, quando ressuscitou dos mortos, seus discípulos se lembraram que ele lhes tinha dito isto; e creram na Escritura, e na palavra que Jesus tinha lhes dito.

versos.grego: Ὡς δὲ ἦν ἐν τοῖς Ἱεροσολύμοις ἐν τῷ πάσχα ἐν τῇ ἑορτῇ, πολλοὶ ἐπίστευσαν εἰς τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ, θεωροῦντες αὐτοῦ τὰ σημεῖα ἃ ἐποίει·

controles.web: Now when he was in Jerusalem at the Passover, during the feast, many believed in his name, observing his signs which he did.
controles.kjv: Now when he was in Jerusalem at the passover, in the feast day, many believed in his name, when they saw the miracles which he did.
controles.livre: E estando ele em Jerusalém pela páscoa, na festa, muitos creram em seu nome, ao verem os sinais que ele fazia.

versos.grego: αὐτὸς δὲ Ἰησοῦς οὐκ ἐπίστευεν αὑτὸν αὐτοῖς διὰ τὸ αὐτὸν γινώσκειν πάντας,

controles.web: But Jesus didn’t trust himself to them, because he knew everyone,
controles.kjv: But Jesus did not commit himself unto them, because he knew all men,
controles.livre: Mas o mesmo Jesus a si mesmo não confiava neles, porque conhecia a todos.

versos.grego: καὶ ὅτι οὐ χρείαν εἶχεν ἵνα τις μαρτυρήσῃ περὶ τοῦ ἀνθρώπου· αὐτὸς γὰρ ἐγίνωσκεν τί ἦν ἐν τῷ ἀνθρώπῳ.

controles.web: and because he didn’t need for anyone to testify concerning man; for he himself knew what was in man.
controles.kjv: And needed not that any should testify of man: for he knew what was in man.
controles.livre: E não necessitava de que alguém lhe desse testemunho de ser humano algum, pois ele bem sabia o que havia no interior do ser humano.
